_about: Song 77, Estética Tijeras, Paty. One set-up, every picture an edit of welcome (as the English salon). Twists: walkin_wait (wait, at wait_q); too_short is said in the reveal turn, so its picture (sorry) shows at the questions that follow it (amb_q, and fix_q when the learner is unhappy).

items.prompt: Paty, the hairdresser, stands beside the first teal styling chair about one third from the left, waving at the learner with one hand as they come in, a big, laugh-ready smile. The round mirrors, the shelf of hair products with blank labels, the wash basin chair and the window onto the sunny street behind her.

Change only this: in the second styling chair sits a client, an older man with deep brown skin and a short white beard under a teal cape, half finished; Paty holds a comb in one hand and points with the other toward a small wooden bench by the window, an apologetic smile, asking the learner to wait a few minutes.
Change only her pose: Paty holds out a glass of water in one hand and a small clay mug of coffee in the other, offering the learner a drink, smiling.

Change only her pose: Paty holds a fine black comb in one hand and, with the other hand raised, shows a small gap between her thumb and index finger (how much to take off), eyebrows raised in a question.
Change only her pose: Paty holds up a pair of electric hair clippers in one hand and a pair of silver scissors in the other, eyebrows raised, asking which one.
Change only her pose: Paty has a folded white towel over one forearm and gestures with her other open hand toward the wash basin chair, a friendly smile.

Change only her pose: Paty laughs as she chats, holding a comb in one hand and showing her phone in the other, its screen a photo of a ginger cat curled up asleep (her cat, Canela), no text on the screen.
Change only her pose: Paty holds a hair dryer in one hand and a round brush in the other, raised and ready, asking how the learner would like it styled, a cheerful look.
Change only her pose: Paty holds up a round hand mirror with a wooden handle, angled toward the learner so they can see the back of their hair, a hopeful, expectant smile.
Change only her pose: Paty holds her scissors loosely in one hand and presses the other hand to her cheek, an embarrassed, apologetic grimace, offering to fix it.
Change only her pose: Paty holds the card terminal out toward the learner in one hand, its screen blank, a friendly smile.
Change only her pose: Paty holds an open appointment book against her chest, the page a grid of blank lines, a pen in her other hand, smiling warmly, offering to book the next appointment.
